column_semantics: The schedule has separate columns for Reference Rate and Spread and Interest Rate. The Interest Rate column shows the stated total coupon; when a portion is PIK, the PIK amount is included parenthetically in that same Interest Rate value, or the whole Interest Rate is marked PIK.

rationale: The printed March 31, 2026 schedule does not provide separate Cash and PIK interest columns. Instead, PIK appears in the single Interest Rate column as included in the displayed rate, for example 9.52% (incl 1.85% PIK), 10.25% (incl 3.50% PIK), and 12.19% (inc 3.50% PIK). All-PIK instruments are also shown as the same stated Interest Rate followed by PIK, such as 14.00% PIK. Therefore the filer's stated position-level Interest Rate is the all-in coupon, with PIK included in the stated rate.
